method: Provisional overall sensitivity: adjusted Team Strength = staged baseline Team Strength + 0.25 × conference adjustment. The 0.25 coefficient follows the baseline model's nominal 25% unit component, but this is not a full standardized 25/35/25/15 model rerun. Unit ranks use the already calculated full conference adjustment.
note: Annual fixed preseason conference factors; no individual recruitment data required. Does not rerun per-game adjustments, re-standardize market, competition or results components. Not yet validated.
